description: Fixture catalog for DTOV ephemeral DB. Add a module when a new feature needs data the baseline does not cover.

smoke.name: company-demo
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM companies WHERE slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' AND deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: vacancy-open
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM vacancies WHERE slug = 'engenheiro-fullstack-plataforma' AND status = 'open' AND deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: motivators-def
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM ae_definitions WHERE LOWER(slug) = 'motivators' AND active = TRUE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: dp-profiles-all-employees
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates c JOIN candidate_dp_profiles p ON p.candidate_id = c.id WHERE c.company_id = (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' AND deleted = FALSE) AND c.employment_status = 'employee') >= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates c2 JOIN companies co ON co.id = c2.company_id WHERE co.slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' AND co.deleted = FALSE AND c2.employment_status = 'employee')

smoke.name: company-kudos
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM company_kudos k JOIN companies co ON co.id = k.company_id WHERE co.slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' AND k.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: okr-cycle-assignees
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM okr_activity_assignees a JOIN companies co ON co.id = a.company_id WHERE co.slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' LIMIT 1

smoke.name: whistleblowing-channel
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM whistleblowing_channels ch JOIN companies co ON co.id = ch.company_id WHERE co.slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' AND ch.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: hour-bank-entries
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM employee_hour_bank_entries e JOIN companies co ON co.id = e.company_id WHERE co.slug = 'todos-os-dados-demo' LIMIT 1

smoke.name: open-indexed
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM vacancies WHERE public_page_enabled = TRUE AND public_allow_index = TRUE AND status = 'open' AND deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: closed-public
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM vacancies WHERE public_page_enabled = TRUE AND status = 'closed' AND deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: company-profile
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM companies WHERE website IS NOT NULL AND about_html IS NOT NULL AND deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

smoke.name: job-funnel-events
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM job_funnel_events WHERE event_type = 'job_view' LIMIT 1

smoke.name: referral-code
smoke.sql: SELECT 1 FROM referral_codes WHERE UPPER(code) = 'DTOVREF' AND active = TRUE LIMIT 1
